title: The Workdiaries of Robert Boyle
author: Robert Boyle
institution: Centre for Editing Lives and Letters (UCL), with Birkbeck, University of London and the Royal Society
notes: Editorial and diplomatic transcripts, with images, of Robert Boyle's workdiaries (records of experiments, recipes, reading notes) from the Royal Society and the British Library, with indexes of people, places and books. Counts are ours: 40 workdiaries and about 286,000 words on the 40 editorial text pages (whitespace tokens, including editorial annotations and headings). The site dates from about 2007; its pages show 2025 modification dates (static re-hosting), so it is listed as active, though no new content is evident. Copyright: the site states materials are copyrighted and for personal use.
